detail.longDescription: I've built KT8 Mail, private email you own outright. It runs on your own Cloudflare account, at your own domain. Your mail never passes through my servers and I can't see it. Most Cloudflare apps I've reviewed needed a terminal to install. KT8 Mail installs in a few clicks with "Sign in with Cloudflare", and the code is public so you can check it.. https:// paulobrien.com/kt8-mail-privat e-email-cloudflare/ # Email # Privacy # SelfHosted # Cloudflare # OpenSource
